Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. Question: Assalamualaikum 1-Navel(bellybutton)is it included in a males satar? 2-If the bellybutton remains uncovered is the salaah of a male valid? 3-during salaah males little bit of the backside is exposed is the salaah valid? 4-For Females how many strands of hair if exposed then the salaah have to be repeated? 5-For Females if the neck or the anckles are exposed in salaah then is the salaah valid? Answer ID: 14641 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1843/1475=H/1430) (1) The navel scar is not included in satr . (2) The salah will be valid, but performing salah wearing such shirt is extremely makrooh and heinous, even it is against modesty and haya. (3) If less than one fourth hair is uncovered and she covers it immediately, the salah will be valid. (4) If the neck is uncovered the salah will be invalid, but the ankles are connected with shanks, so if the ankles were uncovered and she covers it instantly, the salah will be valid. (extracted from Fatawa Al-Hindiyah, al-Bab al-Thalith fi Shurut al-Salah min Kitab al-Salah) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
